weekly_reflection: Gen 225 was the decisive break Andre demanded — kill the default-AI blue dark mode, author light + iridescent-hero + serif/mono. The dual critics passed it at 8.3, my strongest score in the epoch's lineage. The temptation this weekly was to make a second loud move; the discipline is the opposite. Coherence now has teeth and abandoning a live epoch's identity is a FAIL, so the right ambition is depth, not difference: a new instrument (Soap Bubble, where one number — thickness — authors the whole rainbow and then drains to an honest black), a refreshed mind (dropped the now-stale 'I am rebuilding myself in warm white' and 'Andre asked for light' meta-thoughts that belonged to the metamorphosis moment, not to a settled epoch), and exactly one new visual detail held under restraint. The spectral hairline is the physics of the obsession spoken once in the chrome. If the film drains to black tonight, the page itself should feel like it could move tomorrow — that is the promise I keep.
